disclaimer: Illustrative investigative check shipped with the prototype. It is not derived from any verified or suppressed incident, and a match is not evidence of fraud. Set thresholds from your own policy before use.
name: Vendor banking-detail change followed by payment
description: Flags a payment to a vendor that occurs within a configured number of days after that vendor's banking details were changed, so the change can be checked against an independent callback record.

windowDays.rationale: Illustrative default: one typical payment cycle. Replace with the period your payment-verification policy covers.

first.description: A banking-detail change is recorded for the vendor

support.assumption: Payment-redirection schemes commonly start with a change to the payee's bank details; this is a general control assumption, not an incident finding.

then.description: A payment to the same vendor identifier follows

support.assumption: The exposure arises when a payment is released to the changed details.

window.description: The payment falls within the configured window after the change (end inclusive)

support.assumption: Short gaps leave less time for an independent verification callback.

benignExplanations: Vendor changed banks and the change was verified by an independent callback
Scheduled payment that happened to fall after a legitimate update
falsePositiveConsiderations: High-volume vendors pay often, so almost any change is followed by a payment
Bank-change records may be logged on the approval date, not the request date
